function pair(f: ((...args: [string, number]) => void) | ((...args: [string, boolean]) => void)) {
  f();
  f('text');
}
pair((text: string, value: number) => console.log(text, value));
function single(f: ((...args: [number]) => void) | ((...args: [string]) => void)) {
  f();
}
single((value: number) => console.log(value));
function prefix(f: ((label: string, ...args: [number]) => void) | ((label: string, ...args: [boolean]) => void)) {
  f('label');
}
prefix((label: string, value: number) => console.log(label, value));
function variadic(f: ((...args: [string, number, ...boolean[]]) => void) | ((...args: [string, string, ...number[]]) => void)) {
  f();
  f('prefix');
}
variadic((label: string, value: number) => console.log(label, value));
function optional(f: ((...args: [string, number?]) => void) | ((...args: [string, boolean?]) => void)) {
  f();
  f('optional', undefined);
}
optional((label: string, value?: number) => console.log(label, value));
function acceptsVoid(f: ((label: string | void, ...args: [number]) => void) | ((label: string | void, ...args: [string]) => void)) {
  f();
}
acceptsVoid((label: string | void, value: number) => console.log(label, value));
